g.text: UC4 - Compare several countries on one or more indicators
- country list (ISO3 code, name) already loaded
- period from 1975 to the latest available year
- optional: one country preselected from its profile (UC3)
one or more indicators and a period
Send the request to the controller
Show an error message with a retry button
Show the message "Unknown country or indicator"
Desktop view: one line chart per indicator,
Smartphone view: one chart at a time
- one time series per Country and Indicator (year, value, unit)
- countries without any value marked "No data"
of the selected Countries and Indicators
